title: A Morning Prayer Before You Start Your Day | Give God The First Part Of Your Morning
description:
A morning prayer before you start your day. Before the phone, the messages and the bad news, give God the first part of your morning.

Ten minutes of Scripture and prayer to start the day with God: his mercies are new this morning, this is the day he made, and he goes with you wherever you go today.

"This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it." Psalm 118:24 (KJV)

Scriptures in this video (KJV): Lamentations 3:22-23, Psalm 118:24, Mark 1:35, Psalm 5:3, Psalm 143:8, Matthew 6:33-34, Philippians 4:6-7, Proverbs 3:5-6, Psalm 119:105, Isaiah 40:31, Joshua 1:9.

Type amen in the comments, and send this to a friend who needs it. Subscribe to Blessed Prayers for more.
